summary: Rentokil Initial plc filed a Form 6-K on 2026-08-04, reporting a major-holdings notification (TR-1) from Janus Henderson Group Ltd. The notification, dated 03-Aug-2026, discloses that Janus Henderson crossed below a 5% voting-rights threshold as of 30-Jul-2026, holding 4.995136% of voting rights (4.939772% in shares and 0.055364% via CFDs). No transaction terms, prices, or strategic actions are involved. The filing is a routine regulatory disclosure of a passive holding change, not a special situation. What to watch: further dilution or accumulation by Janus Henderson that may approach notices thresholds.
